xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4999: pan tell rejects a conversation's bare name; only the conv- prefixed name works

plan.title: pan tell rejects a conversation's bare name; only the conv- prefixed name works
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A name-shaped target such as 20261103-3f3a falls through resolveCliAgentTarget (src/cli/agent-target.ts) to the issue branch. resolveAgentTarget then returns the canonical agent-20261103-3f3a even though no such agent exists, and messageAgent throws 'Agent agent-20261103-3f3a not running' (src/lib/agents/messaging.ts:704). The conversation table is never consulted, so a running conversation is reported as not running and the operator never sees the accepted-forms list.
narratives.Proposal: In the shared resolver, keep issue-shaped input (/^[A-Za-z]+-\d+$/) on today's issue path. Route other name-shaped input through a new resolveNameShaped helper: look the raw input up as a conversation name, check whether the agent directory <AGENTS_DIR>/<resolveAgentTarget(resolveIssueId(input))> exists, then return the conversation's tmuxSession (conversation only), today's issue result (agent only), ambiguous (both) or unresolved with a reason that names every form tried (neither). Add the bare name to ACCEPTED_TARGET_FORMS, add resolver unit tests, and state the bare-name form in the pan-tell/kill/pause/unpause skills and docs/USAGE.md. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4999.md for exact code.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Reaching a conversation by its bare name when the name is issue-shaped (e.g. a conversation named pan-1148); conv/<name> and conv-<name> cover it
- Case-insensitive conversation-name lookup
- Changing messageAgent's 'Agent <id> not running' error in src/lib/agents/messaging.ts
- Changing pan tell's --when-limit-resets or lane-verdict guards, which slice conv- off the agent ID
- Changing rowToLegacyConversation's conv-<name> default for a null tmux_session
- Making non-prefixed agent directories (ext-…, cctest) addressable by raw name
- Adding any export to the src/lib/agents.js barrel or editing the mocks of existing resolver test suites
- Changing any CLI help string or tell-register.ts

autoDecisions.summary: Issue-shaped input (/^[A-Za-z]+-\d+$/) never consults the conversation table.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps pan tell PAN-123 unchanged and keeps the lazily-imported conversation DB module off the hot path; a conversation named like an issue ID stays reachable through conv/<name>.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent-directory existence (not state.json) decides between today's issue path and unresolved for name-shaped input.
autoDecisions.rationale: Remote (Fly) agents persist only remote-state.json, and suffix forms such as PAN-1148-review must keep resolving to agent-pan-1148-review.

autoDecisions.summary: Use an inline ISSUE_ID_SHAPE regex instead of parseIssueId.
autoDecisions.rationale: kill.test.ts mocks lib/issue-id.js without parseIssueId and vitest throws on a missing mocked export; Rally IDs still resolve through the agent-directory check.

autoDecisions.summary: A name matching both a conversation and an agent directory is ambiguous.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors resolveBareDigits; guessing could deliver a message to the wrong recipient.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix lives in the shared resolver, so tell, kill, pause, unpause, untroubled and conv pending all gain the bare-name form.
autoDecisions.rationale: All six already route through resolveCliAgentTarget; a per-command fix would diverge.

expected_outputs: all listed resolver suites pass with their existing mocks unchanged

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/cli/agent-target.ts: import existsSync (node:fs), join (node:path) and AGENTS_DIR (../lib/paths.js); add const ISSUE_ID_SHAPE = /^[A-Za-z]+-\d+$/; add async resolveNameShaped(input) that computes issueId = resolveIssueId(input), agentId = resolveAgentTarget(issueId), agentExists = agentId !== null && existsSync(join(AGENTS_DIR, agentId)), looks up the raw input via the existing lookupConversation, treats a vault row as no row, then returns ambiguous (both; candidates [{explicitForm: agentId, label: `agent ${agentId}`}, conversationCandidate(row)]), {kind:'agent', agentId: row.tmuxSession, via:'conversation'} (conversation only), {kind:'issue', issueId} (agent only), or unresolved with reason `no conversation named ${input} and no agent ${agentLabel}` / `conversation lookup failed: ${message}; no agent ${agentLabel}` (neither). Replace the final `return { kind: 'issue', issueId: resolveIssueId(input) };` with `if (ISSUE_ID_SHAPE.test(input)) return { kind: 'issue', issueId: resolveIssueId(input) }; return resolveNameShaped(input);`. Update the module header and resolveCliAgentTarget JSDoc to mention conversation names (PAN-4999). Do not change resolveCliSingleAgentId, resolveBareDigits, resolveExplicitConversationForm, any command file, or the agents.js barrel.

items.title: Given a local conversation named 20260928-7563, when resolveCliAgentTarget('20260928-7563') runs, then it returns { kind: 'agent', agentId: 'conv-20260928-7563', via: 'conversation' } and getConversationByName receives the raw lower-case name
Given input PAN-1148, when resolveCliAgentTarget runs, then it returns { kind: 'issue', issueId: 'PAN-1148' } without calling getConversationByName or getConversationById

Given no conversation and no agent directory for 20261103-zzzz, when resolveCliAgentTarget runs, then it returns unresolved with reason exactly 'no conversation named 20261103-zzzz and no agent agent-20261103-zzzz'

Given an existing agent directory agent-pan-1148-review and no matching conversation, when resolveCliAgentTarget('PAN-1148-review') runs, then it returns { kind: 'issue', issueId: 'PAN-1148-REVIEW' } as before this change

The existing suites tell.test.ts, kill.test.ts, kill-conv-target.test.ts, pause-conv-target.test.ts, bare-numeric-id-resolution.test.ts and agent-targeting.test.ts each passes with no edits to its file
